decisions.reason: The source changes only the code-used mint-success modal copy; it does not direct any change to the About page.
Mentioning the selected NFT's title in a success modal does not change certificate delivery, contents, or ebook access actions.
The modal describes the already-established $5 commission and recipient; it does not change the commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, or timing.
The client specifies copy for the mint-success modal only and does not request a corresponding FAQ revision.
The new text applies after a code-used mint succeeds, not to referral-code validation rules or pre-mint valid/invalid feedback.
The source restates the existing $5 commission and prize ticket in UI copy without changing mint price or revenue allocation.
The mint-success modal wording does not change wallet creation, custody, holdings, access paths, or confirmation-email contents.
The source explicitly concerns mints where a referral code is used and does not alter no-referral commission allocation.
The modal reports that a ticket was given but does not change ticket crediting, counters, accounting, display consistency, or backfill rules.
The source changes post-mint feedback copy and does not change the USDC payment, approval, or mint-execution flow.
The source does not mention or alter Transak, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, or the deferred fiat-mint flow.
The source specifies copy for a mint-success modal rather than changing landing-page mechanics copy or emphasis.
